"""Load the frozen review-head implementation for regression reproduction."""

from pathlib import Path


def pytest_configure(config):
    from axiom_encode.harness import manual_locator_metadata, source_completeness

    metadata = Path(__file__).with_name("manual_locator_metadata_old.py")
    exec(
        compile(metadata.read_text(), str(metadata), "exec"),
        manual_locator_metadata.__dict__,
    )
    frozen = Path(__file__).with_name("source_completeness_old.py")
    exec(compile(frozen.read_text(), str(frozen), "exec"), source_completeness.__dict__)
